key_insight: Acoustically levitated liquid marbles evaporate like pure droplets at moderate humidity, but their particle shells strongly alter evaporation and shape change at high and low humidity.
engineering_relevance: The results support contact-free microreactors and microfluidic handling by showing when liquid marbles behave predictably and when shell effects must be accounted for.
method: Acoustic levitation of liquid marbles and pure water droplets
Background-oriented Schlieren (BOS) to visualize surrounding vapor concentration fields
evidence_signal: Simultaneous morphology and vapor-field measurements showed close agreement with pure water droplets at 40% RH, with clear deviations at higher and lower humidity.
watch_item: The shell-induced evaporation resistance and flattening may reduce model transferability across humidity conditions, so operating environment must be controlled.
paper_title: Airborne liquid marble: Evaporation dynamics of liquid marble in acoustic levitation
